name: Shaan Zaidi
headline: Founder & Chief Executive Officer | FivePearls Property Funds
about:
With over 30 years of progressive experience in technology, property, funds management, and financial services, I am a seasoned leader and have a successful track record of building and executing hyper-growth business models for multiple industries, setting sales quotas and targets, and growing revenue and results across APAC and Japan in particular. 

As the Chief Executive and Investment Officer at FivePearls, Australia's first premier Shariah-compliant property fund, I am committed to empowering Australian Muslims to partake in financially sound and ethically sourced solutions that align with the principles of Islamic jurisprudence. I oversee the management of high-performing halal-certified property ventures, offering investors competitive returns and social impact. I also leverage my expertise in software solutions for AI, machine learning, data science, blockchain, and enterprise business solutions to enhance the efficiency and performance of our platform. My core focus is to educate, unify, and elevate the lifestyle and standard of our communities across Australia.
… more

experiences.description:
FivePearls was founded with a clear and ambitious purpose: to create an Australian property investment platform that helps people get ahead, not just get by.

At a time when household debt continues to weigh heavily on families, FivePearls was established to offer a practical alternative. By focusing on real, asset-backed property investments in Australia’s strongest growth corridors, the platform enables investors to generate income streams that can be used to pay down mortgages faster, reduce debt and regain financial momentum.

The investment approach is deliberately disciplined and transparent. FivePearls specialises in land-only residential projects, avoiding unnecessary construction risk, and structures every opportunity with strong downside protection and clear governance. The objective is not short-term speculation, but consistent, repeatable outcomes that support long-term financial security.

Beyond returns, FivePearls is driven by a belief that financial progress strengthens communities. When individuals are empowered to improve their financial position, families become more resilient and communities grow stronger. That philosophy underpins the way FivePearls operates, partners and invests.

FivePearls is still at the beginning of its journey. Built for longevity and designed to grow alongside its investors, the platform represents a long-term vision for responsible wealth creation in Australia.

This is just the beginning.

YourNest is a boutique realestate investment company for property developments funds and residential projects in Sydney’s North West Region, with a current pipeline of over one billion dollars.

As a land developer, master planner and builder, YourNest is uniquely placed to maximise the size of dwellings on given parcels of lands while delivering finished homes that embody ‘modern living’ through the balanced fusion of cutting edge design, thoughtful use of space, quality materials and workmanship together with smart technology.

YourNest takes great pride in anticipating the current and future needs of homeowners, typically adding extra features that future proof homes while delivering exceptional value to homeowners.

Many of YourNest’s people live and work within the local communities that the company helps create, so the team has a natural passion to ensure that each development is something that both YourNest, and the local community, can be extremely proud of.

Evolution is inevitable in the business world…. Today the most innovative solutions lie in the cloud.
Inserito is a technology company driving the constant process of evolution to bring the most advanced level of technological solutions. Inserito aims to affiliate our brand with corporate clientele who aspire to advance in their respective industries.

We are technologically fluent and equipped to handle all segments at the corporate level – From startups to multinationals.

INSERITO derived from Italian, meaning ‘plugged-in’-seamlessly plugs into your business, It’s a perfect fit. Through our world-class IT Managed Services and Solutions, we reach a myriad of highly successful, productive businesses around the clock.‘We think locally but act globally.’ This is our unique selling proposition. Every country, culture, and business requires a specialized level of service. Inserito understands your needs. We are your partner of choice!

Castle Group is one of Australia’s leading private development and construction companies, with a pipeline of residential projects valued at over 500 million dollars.

Castle Group was founded on a strong set of values that place the homeowner and community’s needs at the forefront. This means the business is focused on delivering ultimate value to customers and operating with honesty and integrity. Being the landowner, developer and home builder allows Castle Group to custom design homes for each lot in an estate. Rather than trying to ‘best fit’ another builder’s
standard home design on your lot, Castle Group provide well thought out designs with quality inclusions that maximise the use of space. With Castle Group, there are no compromises on quality.

Castle Group’s intimate knowledge of the land on which your home will be built allows for accurate costing and eliminates the risk of variations. For ultimate peace of mind, prices are 100% fixed – including site costs. With a team of in-house town
planners, building designers and architects, Castle Group controls every stage of the design and development process and takes great pride in ‘future proofing’ homes by anticipating the current and future needs of homeowners.

CyberHub was established with the aim of making Cyber Security more available to companies of all sizes. We combine the latest technologies with professional Cyber Security professionals to protect your company. Every business is undergoing a technological transformation, and we're here to help you protect your innovation by addressing all security concerns and threats.

We believe that through team work, creative technologies, and great people, even the most difficult obstacles can be solved. We keep your company better secured 24/7, 365 days a year by combining the best of all of these components. What's the end result? Improved risk profile for the business, substantial operating cost savings, and long-term peace of mind.

As an extension of your IT team we provide guidance on security tools and help you gain the most value from your portfolio of solutions. Our methodology is clear: Optimize, Overlay & Respond. We stand by this to ensure your environment is as secure and performant as possible. Let us take care of your security so you can continue to focus on your business.
